name: Leipzig Corpora Collection zho_wikipedia_2018_300K

licence.name: CC BY (per Leipzig terms of usage for downloadable corpora); the underlying Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA at origin
licence.method: The live terms page could not be fetched directly (anti-bot interstitial), so the Internet Archive snapshot 20260206070156 of that page was used. It states that the text corpora offered for download are made available under CC BY; the CC BY-NC clause on the same page applies to the web applications, not the downloads. The note about the Wikipedia origin licence is general knowledge about Wikipedia, not something verified on the Leipzig page.

used_for: language model (bigram/trigram training pool) and name-model weight estimation; NOT used for evaluation
redistribution: No. Fetched on demand into ~/.cache/biling-corpus/; the repository ships only aggregate n-gram statistics inside lexicon.sqlite3, never the text.
citation: D. Goldhahn, T. Eckart and U. Quasthoff: Building Large Monolingual Dictionaries at the Leipzig Corpora Collection. LREC 2012.
